Title: Seattle Art Museum
Note: Downtown. The Hammering Man out front never stops.

Title: Elliott Bay Book Company
Note: Capitol Hill. Wooden floors, a cafe, and hours will disappear.

Title: The Museum of Flight
Note: Boeing Field. You can board a retired Concorde and Air Force One.

Title: Chihuly Garden and Glass
Note: Touristy and worth it. Do it on the worst weather day.

Title: Seattle Central Library
Note: Rem Koolhaas. Take the escalator to the Books Spiral and look up.

Title: Museum of Pop Culture
Note: The building is Frank Gehry. The sci-fi wing is the good part.
